page: HonoRequest: wraps Request object, accessible from c.req. Provides methods for accessing request data: param(), query(), queries(), header(), parseBody(), json(), text(), arrayBuffer(), blob(), formData(), valid(). Properties: routePath (deprecated), matchedRoutes (deprecated), path, url, method, raw. Clone request with cloneRawRequest() after body consumed. Single file upload to body['foo'], multiple use body['foo[]'], all option for multiple fields, dot notation for structured parsing.

sections.manifest: param(): get path parameter value or all params. c.req.param('id') returns single, c.req.param() returns all as object.
query(): get querystring parameter value or all params. c.req.query('q') returns single, c.req.query() returns all as object.
queries(): get multiple querystring values for same key. c.req.queries('tags') returns string[] for /search?tags=A&tags=B.
header(): get request header value. c.req.header('User-Agent') gets single header. c.req.header() without args returns all headers with lowercase keys. Must use exact case for uppercase headers.

parseBody(): parse multipart/form-data or application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Single file: body['foo'] is (string | File), last uploaded used. Multiple files: body['foo[]'] always (string | File)[]. all option parses multiple fields with same name. dot option structures output with dot notation.
valid(): get validated data from middleware validators. Targets: form, json, query, header, cookie, param. See validation guide for usage.
routePath: deprecated in v4.8.0, use routePath() from Route Helper. Returns registered path like /posts/:id.
matchedRoutes: deprecated in v4.8.0, use matchedRoutes() from Route Helper. Returns matched routes for debugging with handler name, method, path.
url: full request URL string, e.g., http://localhost:8787/about/me.
method: HTTP method string, e.g., GET.
raw: raw Request object from Fetch API. For Cloudflare Workers access c.req.raw.cf?.hostMetadata?.
cloneRawRequest(): clone raw Request object after body consumption. Works after validators/methods consumed body. Enables reading body multiple times.
